ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: In couple’s work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they’re projecting to their partner through how they’re sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they’re speaking, and the expressions on their face. It’s being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It’s taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they’re getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it’s the partner’s upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also other-awareness.

It’s being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It’s taking the time to self-soothe, calming ③<u>them</u> back down when they’re getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it’s the partner’s upset that is ④<u>escalating</u> too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also other-awareness.

❌ ③ them → themselves: calming them back down — 주어와 목적어가 같으므로(they=themselves) 재귀대명사 필수

✅ ④ escalating: is escalating — 진행형 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① restoring → restore: that... restore closeness에서 주격 관계대명사 that의 동사는 원형 restore.
det.analysis:
❌ ① restoring → restore: ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness — 관계대명사 that의 동사 restore(원형) 필요. restoring(동명사)은 부적절

✅ ② sitting: how they're sitting — 진행형 적절

det.tip: 관계대명사 that + 동사: 선행사(ones, 복수)에 수 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ too → also: not just A but also B 구문에서 also 필수. too는 이 구문에 사용 불가.
det.analysis:
✅ ① aware: become more aware — 형용사 보어 적절

✅ ② at which: the volume at which they're speaking — 전치사+관계대명사 적절

✅ ③ unhealthy: unhealthy patterns — 형용사 수식 적절

✅ ③ resolution(해결): 실제로 해결로 이끄는 경로라는 문맥에 적절

✅ ④ upset(화남): 화가 나고 있을 때라는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: In couple’s work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better <u>ones</u> that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they’re projecting to their partner through how they’re sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they’re speaking, and the expressions on their face. It’s being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It’s taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they’re getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it’s the partner’s upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also other-awareness.
